lines.speaker: Spirit
lines.text: The well kept the shape of your fall. I do not think it should be able to do that.

lines.speaker: Spirit
lines.text: I know the shape of a sword. I do not know why.

lines.speaker: Spirit
lines.text: Wait. Do not move the shard.

lines.speaker: Spirit
lines.text: No - move it. I think that is why I am here.

lines.speaker: Spirit
lines.text: I know the shape of a sword. I do not know why.

lines.speaker: Spirit
lines.text: I remembered you falling before I saw you wake.

lines.speaker: Spirit
lines.text: There are too many versions of you here. Please do not look at them too long.
